apps.name: GrandStand
apps.subtitle: Live sport, TV, movies and replays
apps.localizedDescription: Live sport from every source in one place, free-to-air and sports channels, Twitch, full-game replays, and movies and TV shows (with a TorBox account).

versions.localizedDescription: Live sport on free-to-air TV now shows in Home and Live Sport, with the TV channel first on matching games. The player follows a game when it moves between Seven and 7mate, including into the next game of a double header. RugbyBox, MMABox and CricWatch links play again.

Other-language streams are hidden when there are English ones. TV channels (which may be showing something else) now sit at the bottom of the link list, marked 'TV channel'. Select all / Unselect all for your sports. F1 replays: Miami no longer mixed up with the US GP, and more races found. StreamFree links are back.
